Imported Load Cases - Modal: Modal damping due to the effective damping in link elements only.
This item is Yes if the considered mode is a missing mass mode.  Otherwise it is No.

The modal mass for the specified mode.  This is a measure of the kinetic energy in the structure if it is deforming in the specified mode.  Modal mass is calculated as S(transpose)*M*S where S is the mode shape and M is the mass matrix.

Note that the modal period (MP), modal mass (MM) and modal stiffness (MS) are related to each other by the following equation:

   MP = 2*pi*(MM/MS)^0.5

The modal stiffness for the specified mode.  This is a measure of the strain energy in the structure if it is deforming in the specified mode.  Modal stiffness is calculated as S(transpose)*K*S where S is the mode shape and K is the stiffness matrix.

Note that the modal period (MP), modal mass (MM) and modal stiffness (MS) are related to each other by the following equation:

   MP = 2*pi*(MM/MS)^0.5
